upland_game_bird_species.user_verification_basis: Owner supplied the section text on 2026-08-31 from Findlaw's reproduction of California Fish and Game Code section 3683, stated there as current as of January 01, 2026. This is a secondary reproduction, not a fetch from the Legislature's own site: leginfo.legislature.ca.gov publishes robots.txt 'Disallow: /', so under this project's scrape policy it is the manual lane or nothing. The distinction is recorded in the citation rather than glossed.
upland_game_bird_species.note: The species list that decides who needs a California Upland Game Bird Validation. The regulations booklet requires the validation for 'upland game birds' and then defines that class ONLY by pointing here (FGC 3682.1 -> 3683), which is why the app could not answer the dove question from CDFW's own PDFs alone.
upland_game_bird_species.why_this_looked_contradictory: Section 506 groups mourning and white-winged doves with 'migratory game birds' for shooting hours, and CDFW's Resident Small Game chapter points dove hunters AWAY to section 507. That reads as though dove is not an upland game bird. Section 3683 resolves it: the class 'upland game bird' is defined to INCLUDE both resident game birds (subdivision (a)) and certain migratory game birds (subdivision (b)). Mourning doves, white-winged doves, band-tailed pigeons and jacksnipe sit in (b). Both statements are true at once - a dove is a migratory game bird AND an upland game bird - so the validation is required and the migratory shooting hours also apply.

records.summary: Yes — dove counts. Mourning and white-winged doves are named in the statute.
records.evidence_quote: Upland game bird species include both of the following: ... (b) All of the following migratory game birds: Jacksnipe. Western mourning doves. White-winged doves. Band-tailed pigeons.
records.clarification: This looks contradictory in CDFW's own documents and is not. Section 506 files mourning and white-winged doves under migratory game birds for shooting hours, and the Resident Small Game chapter sends dove hunters away to section 507. But Fish and Game Code section 3683 defines upland game birds to include BOTH resident game birds and certain migratory ones — and lists western mourning doves, white-winged doves, band-tailed pigeons and jacksnipe among them. A dove is a migratory game bird and an upland game bird at the same time, so the migratory shooting hours apply AND the Upland Game Bird Validation is required.

citation.source_doc: California Fish and Game Code § 3683, as reproduced by Findlaw (owner-supplied transcription; stated current as of January 01, 2026)
